results.question: Which 5 states had the highest GMV in 2018?
results.answer_summary: The top 5 states with the highest GMV in 2018 were São Paulo (SP), Rio de Janeiro (RJ), Minas Gerais (MG), Rio Grande do Sul (RS), and Paraná (PR). Their GMVs were 2975612.23, 906646.41, 857267.8, 387089.8, and 385875.82, respectively.

results.question: Show the monthly late delivery rate in 2018.
results.answer_summary: The monthly late delivery rate in 2018 was as follows: January had 10.1%, February had 6.6%, March had 15.8%, April had 18.6%, May had 6.6%, June had 8.4%, July had 1.7%, August had 10.5%, September had 100%, and October also had 100%.
results.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', delivered_at) AS period, COUNT(CASE WHEN delivered_at > estimated_delivery_at THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(*) AS late_delivery_rate FROM stg_orders WHERE YEAR(delivered_at) = 2018 GROUP BY period ORDER BY period LIMIT 200

metrics_used.name: late_delivery_rate
metrics_used.label: Late delivery rate
metrics_used.description: Share of delivered orders that arrived after the estimated delivery date (compared as calendar dates). Equals 1 minus on-time delivery rate.
metrics_used.expression: AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

assumptions.data_coverage: Olist purchases Sep 2016 to Oct 2018; default analysis window 2017-01-01 to 2018-09-01 (end exclusive), by purchase date.
notes: Assumes 'delivered_at' is the date when the order was delivered.
